name: team_planning_create_plan
description: Create a Team Planning plan, a private draft of the organisation built on the Org Graph as it stood on base_on (today by default). It covers the whole organisation, or with unit_ids only those units and everything under them; the scope can be widened later. Only its members see it, and its creator is its first editor. Refused unless the caller is a tenant admin or a planner, linked to a person.

unit_ids.description: the units it covers, each with everything under it; none for the whole organisation
